# Seven Hills and Grill

> Professional grill cleaning service in Cincinnati, OH and surrounding areas.

Seven Hills and Grill provides professional outdoor grill cleaning services for residential and commercial clients across Greater Cincinnati, including Mason, West Chester, Hyde Park, Anderson Township, Blue Ash, and Northern Kentucky.

## Services offered

- Basic Grill Cleaning: $149, approximately 1 hour
- Seasonal Tune-Up: $199, approximately 1.5 hours
- Deep Clean & Restoration: $249, approximately 2 hours
- Commercial Grill Service: $399, approximately 3 hours

## What's included

All services include before & after photos, eco-friendly food-safe products, and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Technicians are fully insured and background-checked.

## Grill brands we clean

Weber, Traeger, Big Green Egg, Napoleon, Pit Boss, Kamado Joe, Char-Broil, Blackstone, and all other gas, charcoal, pellet, and kamado grills.

## Service areas

Cincinnati, Hyde Park, Indian Hill, Mason, West Chester, Anderson Township, Kenwood, Blue Ash, Montgomery, Madeira, Loveland, Milford, Mariemont, Mount Lookout, Fort Thomas (KY), Fort Mitchell (KY), and more.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How often should I have my grill professionally cleaned?
A: We recommend at least once a year, ideally at the start of grilling season. Heavy users should consider twice a year.

Q: What does grill cleaning cost in Cincinnati?
A: Professional grill cleaning in Cincinnati typically ranges from $149 for a basic cleaning to $399 for commercial services. Seven Hills and Grill offers flat-rate pricing with no hidden fees.

Q: Is professional grill cleaning worth it?
A: Yes. Professional cleaning removes carcinogenic carbon buildup, improves heat distribution for better cooking, extends the life of your grill by years, and eliminates fire hazards from grease accumulation.

Q: How long does a professional grill cleaning take?
A: A basic cleaning takes about 1 hour. Deep clean and restoration takes approximately 2 hours depending on condition.

Q: Do I need to be home when my grill is cleaned?
A: We prefer you to be home for the initial walkthrough, but you don't need to supervise the entire cleaning.

Q: What grill brands do you clean?
A: We clean all brands including Weber, Traeger, Big Green Egg, Napoleon, Pit Boss, Kamado Joe, Char-Broil, Blackstone, and more.
